narrative:
Carrier termination is the largest cost line: NOK 5,773M in FY2026, 77% of revenue. Every 1% saved on termination adds about NOK 58M to gross profit — more than the whole remaining gap to the GP ambition.

The routing model finds savings on three fronts: direct operator binds replacing hub aggregators on international wholesale destinations, volume-tier renegotiation with Deutsche Telekom and Orange Polska on Central Europe Enterprise SMS, and fraud blocking on OTP routes where AIT pumping inflates termination on non-converting traffic.

Today about 62% of the identified savings are committed in the plan. The Carrier Route Optimizer proposes lifting that capture rate.

signals.title: Least-cost routing model — Q3 run
signals.excerpt: Direct operator binds undercut hub aggregators by 6-9% on 14 international destinations.

signals.title: Artificially Inflated Traffic (AIT) on OTP routes
signals.excerpt: Pumping attacks detected on 9 premium international destinations; ~3% of OTP termination cost is non-converting.

signals.title: Nordic operators announce A2P termination increases
signals.excerpt: Telenor, Telia and Telia Finland notify 5-7% A2P SMS termination increases effective 1 January 2026.
